diseases.name: Primary dysmenorrhoea
diseases.inv: Clinical; pelvic ultrasound if atypical.

diseases.name: Endometriosis / adenomyosis
diseases.inv: Pelvic ultrasound, MRI; laparoscopy by gynaecologist.

diseases.name: Ovarian torsion
diseases.inv: Urgent pelvic ultrasound with Doppler; urgent gynaecology review. A normal Doppler does not exclude torsion.

diseases.name: Ruptured or haemorrhagic ovarian cyst
diseases.inv: Pregnancy test, pelvic ultrasound, haemoglobin.

diseases.name: Chronic pelvic pain syndrome
diseases.inv: Pelvic ultrasound, STI screen, urine, consider laparoscopy.

diseases.name: Fetal compromise / intrauterine fetal demise
diseases.inv: Same-day assessment: fetal heart auscultation, CTG, ultrasound, BP, urine protein, glucose.
diseases.alt: Normal variation, anterior placenta, maternal distraction

diseases.name: Labour
diseases.inv: Obstetric assessment: contractions, cervical examination (if praevia excluded), fetal heart.
diseases.alt: False labour, preterm labour, abruption, UTI

diseases.name: Preterm labour
diseases.inv: Urgent obstetric assessment, fetal heart, infection screen, steroids and referral per protocol.

diseases.name: False labour (Braxton Hicks)
diseases.inv: Reassess after observation; exclude true labour.

diseases.name: Rupture of membranes (including preterm)
diseases.inv: Sterile speculum examination, check for infection, fetal heart, urgent obstetric review.

diseases.name: Chorioamnionitis
diseases.inv: Urgent obstetric and neonatal review; infection screen, antibiotics per protocol.

diseases.name: Urinary leakage in pregnancy
diseases.inv: Pad test, urine test.

diseases.name: Uterine atony (postpartum haemorrhage)
diseases.inv: Emergency: uterine massage, uterotonics, fluids, blood, per obstetric haemorrhage protocol.
diseases.alt: Genital tract trauma, retained products, coagulopathy

diseases.name: Genital tract trauma bleeding
diseases.inv: Examine for tears under good light; repair by trained clinician.

diseases.name: Retained placenta / products of conception
diseases.inv: Check placenta, ultrasound, removal by trained clinician.

diseases.name: Secondary postpartum haemorrhage / endometritis
diseases.inv: Ultrasound, swabs, CBC; antibiotics per protocol.

diseases.name: Puerperal sepsis (endometritis)
diseases.inv: Blood cultures, high vaginal swab, CBC, urgent senior review and antibiotics per sepsis protocol.

diseases.name: Post-delivery wound infection
diseases.inv: Wound examination and swab; ultrasound for collection.

diseases.name: Mastitis / breast abscess
diseases.inv: Clinical; ultrasound if lump or no improvement; keep feeding or expressing.

diseases.name: Venous thromboembolism after delivery
diseases.inv: Clinical probability and imaging for DVT/PE as appropriate.

diseases.name: Cyclical mastalgia
diseases.inv: Clinical breast examination; imaging per age.

diseases.name: Breast cancer
diseases.inv: Triple assessment: clinical examination, imaging and biopsy.
diseases.tool: Triple assessment is the standard approach to any breast lump.

diseases.name: Fibroadenoma
diseases.inv: Triple assessment; ultrasound.

diseases.name: Breast cyst
diseases.inv: Ultrasound.

diseases.name: Duct papilloma / ductal disease
diseases.inv: Breast imaging, duct evaluation, cytology; exclude cancer.

diseases.name: Nipple trauma / poor breastfeeding attachment
diseases.inv: Observe feeding and attachment.

diseases.name: Insufficient milk intake
diseases.inv: Weigh baby, feeding assessment, nappy output.

diseases.name: Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy
diseases.inv: Clinical; urine ketones; exclude infection.

diseases.name: Hyperemesis gravidarum
diseases.inv: Weight, urine ketones, electrolytes, ultrasound; hospital care if dehydrated.

diseases.name: Molar pregnancy
diseases.inv: Ultrasound, quantitative β-hCG; specialist follow-up.

diseases.name: Menopausal transition
diseases.inv: Clinical in women over 45; FSH is rarely needed.

diseases.name: Premature ovarian insufficiency
diseases.inv: FSH on two occasions, oestradiol, TSH, karyotype as indicated.

diseases.name: Drug-induced flushes
diseases.inv: Medicine review.

diseases.name: Pelvic organ prolapse
diseases.inv: Pelvic examination in standing and straining; POP-Q assessment by specialist.

diseases.name: Ovarian mass (including ovarian cancer)
diseases.inv: Pelvic ultrasound, CA-125 with ultrasound as per risk-of-malignancy assessment, specialist review.
diseases.tool: Risk of malignancy index (RMI) is used by specialists; apply per local guideline.
diseases.alt: Fibroid, ascites from liver disease, pregnancy, bladder distension

diseases.name: Renal mass (e.g. renal cell carcinoma)
diseases.inv: Ultrasound, CT abdomen, urine, CBC.

diseases.name: Gastric cancer
diseases.inv: Urgent endoscopy and biopsy.

diseases.name: Atrophic vaginitis (after cancer exclusion)
diseases.inv: Pelvic ultrasound with endometrial thickness and gynaecology review before accepting this diagnosis.

diseases.name: Therapy-related postmenopausal bleeding
diseases.inv: Review therapy, ultrasound, endometrial sampling if persistent.

diseases.name: Haemorrhoids
diseases.inv: Digital rectal examination and proctoscopy; check haemoglobin; colonoscopy if age or alarm features.
diseases.alt: Anal fissure, colorectal cancer, rectal prolapse

diseases.name: Anal fissure
diseases.inv: Inspection; avoid forceful rectal examination; manage constipation.

diseases.name: Inflammatory bowel disease
diseases.inv: Stool culture and calprotectin, CBC, CRP, colonoscopy with biopsy.

diseases.name: Infective (bacillary) dysentery
diseases.inv: Stool microscopy and culture; hydration; senior review if severe.

diseases.name: Amoebic colitis
diseases.inv: Stool microscopy; ultrasound for liver abscess.

diseases.name: Diverticular or vascular lower GI bleed
diseases.inv: Resuscitation, CBC, colonoscopy or CT angiography per stability.

diseases.name: Juvenile rectal polyp
diseases.inv: Examination, colonoscopy by paediatric surgeon.

diseases.name: Perianal abscess
diseases.inv: Clinical; early surgical drainage; check glucose.

diseases.name: Thrombosed external haemorrhoid
diseases.inv: Clinical.

diseases.name: Proctalgia fugax
diseases.inv: Clinical after other causes excluded.

diseases.name: Anal fistula
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI; consider Crohn disease and TB.

diseases.name: Anorectal cancer
diseases.inv: Digital rectal examination, proctoscopy, biopsy, imaging.

diseases.name: Rectal prolapse
diseases.inv: Examination while straining; colonoscopy as indicated.

diseases.name: Threadworm infestation
diseases.inv: Sellotape test; treat the family per local guideline.

diseases.name: Perianal skin irritation (hygiene, dermatitis, fungal)
diseases.inv: Clinical; skin scraping if fungal suspected.

diseases.name: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease
diseases.inv: Clinical; endoscopy if alarm features or non-response.
diseases.alt: Peptic ulcer, functional dyspepsia, ACS, eosinophilic oesophagitis

diseases.name: Dyspepsia with alarm features (exclude malignancy)
diseases.inv: Urgent upper GI endoscopy and biopsy.

diseases.name: Cardiac cause of "heartburn" (ACS)
diseases.inv: ECG and troponin; treat as cardiac until excluded.

diseases.name: Functional dyspepsia
diseases.inv: Diagnosis after excluding alarm features; test for H. pylori.
diseases.tool: Rome IV criteria define functional dyspepsia; apply separately.

diseases.name: Food (e.g. lactose) intolerance
diseases.inv: Dietary history; elimination trial; hydrogen breath test where available.

diseases.name: Irritable bowel syndrome
diseases.inv: Diagnosis after excluding alarm features; CBC, CRP, coeliac screen.
diseases.tool: Rome IV criteria define IBS; apply separately.
diseases.alt: Coeliac disease, IBD, colorectal cancer, ovarian cancer

diseases.name: Coeliac disease / malabsorption
diseases.inv: Anti-tissue transglutaminase IgA with total IgA, then duodenal biopsy; keep gluten in diet until tested.

diseases.name: Giardiasis
diseases.inv: Stool microscopy or antigen test.

diseases.name: Chronic pancreatitis / pancreatic insufficiency
diseases.inv: Stool elastase, imaging of pancreas, glucose.

diseases.name: Drug-induced nausea or vomiting
diseases.inv: Medicine review.

diseases.name: Neurological cause of nausea (raised ICP, migraine, vestibular)
diseases.inv: Neurological examination, fundoscopy, imaging as indicated.

diseases.name: Pill oesophagitis
diseases.inv: History; endoscopy if persistent; stop offending drug.

diseases.name: Varicose veins / chronic venous insufficiency
diseases.inv: Duplex ultrasound of leg veins.

diseases.name: Superficial thrombophlebitis
diseases.inv: Duplex ultrasound to exclude deep vein involvement.

diseases.name: Bleeding varicose vein
diseases.inv: Firm pressure and leg elevation; urgent care.

diseases.name: Umbilical / paraumbilical hernia
diseases.inv: Clinical; ultrasound if doubt.

diseases.name: Omphalitis
diseases.inv: Urgent paediatric review; swab, blood culture, antibiotics.

diseases.name: Femoral hernia
diseases.inv: Surgical review; early repair advised because of strangulation risk.
diseases.alt: Inguinal hernia, lymph node, saphena varix

diseases.name: Saphena varix
diseases.inv: Duplex ultrasound.

diseases.name: Ascites (liver, heart, kidney or malignant cause)
diseases.inv: Abdominal ultrasound, diagnostic paracentesis with SAAG and cell count, liver and kidney tests.
diseases.alt: Ovarian mass, intestinal obstruction, pregnancy, obesity

diseases.name: Abdominal (peritoneal) tuberculosis
diseases.inv: Ascitic fluid analysis (lymphocytes, ADA), imaging, chest X-ray.

diseases.name: Infantile colic
diseases.inv: Clinical after exclusion of serious causes; reassure and support parents.
diseases.alt: Underfeeding, reflux, cow milk allergy, infection, intussusception

diseases.name: Underfeeding
diseases.inv: Weight, feeding observation, nappy count.

diseases.name: Serious infection in a crying infant
diseases.inv: Urgent paediatric review; full examination, urine, blood tests, cultures.

diseases.name: Intussusception
diseases.inv: Urgent ultrasound and surgical/paediatric review.

diseases.name: Non-accidental injury (child protection concern)
diseases.inv: Full examination with documentation; follow child protection procedures and involve senior paediatrician.
diseases.alt: Accidental injury, bleeding disorder, bone disease

diseases.name: Pathological jaundice in first 24 hours (e.g. haemolytic disease)
diseases.inv: Urgent serum bilirubin, blood group and Coombs test, CBC; phototherapy per age-in-hours nomogram.
diseases.tool: Use age-in-hours bilirubin nomograms (e.g. AAP, NICE or IAP) for treatment thresholds.

diseases.name: Physiological jaundice
diseases.inv: Clinical with bilirubin measurement per local protocol.

diseases.name: Prolonged jaundice / neonatal cholestasis (e.g. biliary atresia)
diseases.inv: Split bilirubin, stool colour card, liver ultrasound; urgent paediatric hepatology referral.

diseases.name: Breast-milk jaundice
diseases.inv: Diagnosis after excluding cholestasis (conjugated bilirubin).

diseases.name: Severe hyperbilirubinaemia with risk of bilirubin brain injury
diseases.inv: Emergency bilirubin, phototherapy and exchange transfusion decisions by neonatal team.

diseases.name: Primary nocturnal enuresis
diseases.inv: Urine test; bladder diary; reassurance and behavioural measures.

diseases.name: Secondary enuresis (diabetes, UTI, constipation, stress)
diseases.inv: Urine dipstick, glucose, constipation assessment.
diseases.alt: Primary enuresis, neurogenic bladder, diabetes insipidus

diseases.name: Neurogenic bladder / spinal cause
diseases.inv: Spine and lower-limb examination, ultrasound, MRI spine.

diseases.name: Iron deficiency anaemia
diseases.inv: CBC, ferritin, peripheral smear, stool for ova; look for the source.
diseases.alt: Thalassaemia trait, chronic disease, B12 deficiency

diseases.name: Thalassaemia / haemoglobinopathy
diseases.inv: CBC, peripheral smear, haemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC.
diseases.alt: Iron deficiency, sickle cell disease, haemolysis

diseases.name: Leukaemia / bone marrow failure
diseases.inv: CBC, peripheral smear, urgent haematology review, marrow examination.
diseases.alt: Iron deficiency, dengue, aplastic anaemia, ITP

diseases.name: Vitamin B12 / folate deficiency
diseases.inv: CBC, smear, B12 and folate levels.
diseases.alt: Iron deficiency, thyroid disease, peripheral neuropathy

diseases.name: Anaemia of chronic disease
diseases.inv: CBC, ferritin, CRP, kidney and liver tests.

diseases.name: Hookworm anaemia
diseases.inv: Stool microscopy, CBC; deworming per national programme.

diseases.name: Severe acute malnutrition
diseases.inv: Weight-for-height/MUAC by WHO standards, appetite test, look for infection and hypoglycaemia; refer to nutrition rehabilitation.
diseases.tool: WHO child growth standards and MUAC cut-offs define malnutrition; follow national guidelines.

diseases.name: Inadequate nutritional intake
diseases.inv: Feeding history, observation, growth chart.

diseases.name: Chronic illness affecting growth (TB, HIV, heart, kidney)
diseases.inv: CBC, Mantoux/IGRA, HIV test, urine and kidney tests, echocardiography as indicated.

diseases.name: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
diseases.inv: Urgent oxygen saturation, hyperoxia test, chest X-ray, ECG, echocardiography, cardiology review.

diseases.name: Acrocyanosis (benign)
diseases.inv: Check central colour and oxygen saturation to exclude central cyanosis.

diseases.name: Specific learning disorder
diseases.inv: Psychoeducational assessment after vision and hearing checks.
diseases.alt: Vision or hearing problem, ADHD, intellectual disability, anxiety

diseases.name: Undetected vision or hearing problem
diseases.inv: Vision and hearing screening.

diseases.name: Absence epilepsy
diseases.inv: EEG; neurology review.

diseases.name: Psychosocial cause (stress, bullying, abuse, low mood)
diseases.inv: Sensitive interview with child and parents; screen for abuse and depression.

diseases.name: Global developmental delay / intellectual disability
diseases.inv: Developmental assessment, hearing and vision tests, thyroid and metabolic tests, genetic tests as indicated.
diseases.alt: Hearing loss, autism, hypothyroidism, cerebral palsy

diseases.name: Hearing impairment in a child
diseases.inv: Audiology (OAE/BERA).

diseases.name: Cerebral palsy
diseases.inv: Neurological examination, MRI brain, multidisciplinary assessment.
diseases.alt: Metabolic disease, spinal disorder, global delay

diseases.name: Neurodevelopmental regression (neurodegenerative or metabolic disease)
diseases.inv: Urgent paediatric neurology review; MRI, metabolic and genetic tests.

diseases.name: Peripheral neuropathy (diabetic, alcohol, B12, other)
diseases.inv: Glucose/HbA1c, B12, TSH, creatinine, nerve conduction studies.

diseases.name: Hypocalcaemia / hyperventilation
diseases.inv: Serum calcium, magnesium, phosphate, ECG; arterial gas if breathing fast.
diseases.alt: Panic disorder, tetany of other cause

diseases.name: Multiple sclerosis / demyelination
diseases.inv: MRI brain and spine; neurology referral.
diseases.alt: B12 deficiency, vascular disease, functional disorder

diseases.name: Systemic illness with loss of appetite (infection, malignancy, organ failure)
diseases.inv: History and examination to find the system involved; CBC, CRP, glucose, kidney, liver and thyroid tests, chest X-ray, HIV and TB screening as indicated.

diseases.name: Depression causing poor appetite
diseases.inv: Clinical interview; screen for physical illness.

diseases.name: Influenza-like illness
diseases.inv: Clinical; testing per local policy.
diseases.tool: Use national influenza surveillance case definitions.

diseases.name: Fibromyalgia
diseases.inv: Diagnosis after excluding other causes; TSH, CBC, ESR/CRP, vitamin D, CK.
diseases.tool: ACR criteria are used by clinicians; apply separately.

flags.text: Reduced fetal movements: needs same-day assessment with CTG and ultrasound
Leaking fluid in pregnancy: assess for rupture of membranes and infection
Fever or foul discharge with leaking fluid: possible intrauterine infection, urgent
Contractions before 37 weeks: possible preterm labour, urgent
Fever with foul lochia and tender uterus after delivery: possible puerperal sepsis, urgent
Swollen calf or chest pain after delivery: possible thromboembolism, urgent
Sudden severe one-sided pelvic pain with vomiting: possible ovarian torsion, urgent
Bleeding after menopause: needs cancer exclusion
Heavy bleeding with uterus larger than dates or grape-like tissue: possible molar pregnancy, urgent
Constant throbbing anal pain with swelling and fever: possible perianal abscess, needs urgent drainage
Heartburn triggered by exertion with sweating: treat as cardiac, urgent ECG
Trouble swallowing, weight loss, vomiting blood or anaemia with indigestion: needs urgent endoscopy
Painful bulge that will not go back with vomiting: possible strangulated hernia, emergency
Red swollen navel with discharge in a newborn: possible omphalitis, urgent
Bleeding varicose vein: firm pressure, elevate, urgent care
Blue tongue and lips: central cyanosis, give oxygen and get urgent assessment
Waves of severe pain with vomiting and redcurrant stool in an infant: possible intussusception, urgent
Jaundice in the first 24 hours: urgent bilirubin and haemolysis work-up
Deep jaundice with lethargy or arching: risk of bilirubin brain injury, emergency
Jaundice beyond 2 weeks with pale stools: possible biliary atresia, urgent referral
Severe wasting or swelling of both feet: severe acute malnutrition, urgent nutrition care
Unexplained injuries with inconsistent history: possible child abuse, follow child protection procedure
Loss of previously learned skills: urgent neurology review
